bio: Devised the Sorang Sompeng script for the Sora language in 1936, its 24 letters named for deities in the Sora pantheon, resolving a dispute over which script to use.

sources.title: Sora Sompeng - Atlas of Endangered Alphabets
Asoka Kumara Dasababu, Guru Mangei Gamango (Academy of Tribal Dialects & Culture, 1996) — CiNii catalogue record giving lifespan 1916-1980
